newsitem.title: USA: Chevron Calif. refinery units shut late Feb..
newsitem.headline: Chevron Calif. refinery units shut late Feb..

text.p: Chevron Corp plans to shut several units at its 225,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery in Richmond, Calif., for two weeks planned maintenance in late February, an industry source said.
"They'll still be making stuff, but at a lower rate," said a source familiar with plant operations.
The units include a TKN and A-train unit.
Seperately, the plant's fluid catalytic cracker (FCC) unit returned to service in late December after shutting earlier in the month for tubing repairs.
